# Day Cluster Core

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The core set of daily notes within a Day Cluster - typically Plan, Log, Journal, and Review.

## Scope note

Distinguish from DayClusterSupport (Links, Actions), DayClusterHealth (health event data), and DayClusterVisual (visual/graph tools).
